articleTitle: Mobile Application for Indian Currency Verification Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Counterfeit notes are one of the biggest concerns in day-today transactions, and negatively affect a country’s economy. Nowadays, due to the use of advanced technologies in the production of counterfeit banknotes, it is almost impossible to detect counterfeit currencies with bare eyes. Thus, there is a need to make use of technologies for the detection of counterfeit currencies. Currently, certain dedicated devices are available for detecting counterfeit currency; however, they are not accessible to the common people. This paper proposes a deep learning-based solution for counterfeit currency detection (CCD). Furthermore, the proposed models integration on mobile devices will provide scalability and thus accessibility to every ordinary man. Therefore, three state-of-the-art pre-trained models, VGG16, InceptionV3, and ResNet50 are introduced. The results of each of the models performances are compared and analyzed. The best-performing model has 99% training accuracy and is recommended for deployment as a mobile application. The obtained result is almost outperforming the current state-of-the-art techniques with an acceptable average test accuracy of 97.3% to check whether the currency is fake or real. The best performing model is securely executed on mobile devices.

articleTitle: Enhancing Road Safety through Adaptive Headlight System for Two-Wheelers
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: A blind corner refers to a curve or bend in a road or pathway where visibility is significantly limited or obstructed. These corners make it difficult for drivers, cyclists, or pedestrians to see oncoming vehicles, objects, or individuals from their current vantage point. The lack of visibility around these corners increases the risk of accidents because it is challenging to anticipate and react to potential hazards or oncoming traffic. Blind corners can be caused by various factors, including natural features like hills or bends, buildings or structures obstructing the view, or dense foliage along the roadside. Our project is about two-wheeler headlamp systems, and there is a lot of research going on in this subject right now. As a result, we created a prototype of an adaptive cornering headlight as a solution to the above problem. A microcontroller is used to design this prototype model. Conventional headlights cannot compensate for light projection on a curved and unpaved road at night, and an autonomous adjusting beam helps to optimize illumination of the road ahead this overcomes accidents at cornering/turning due to poor illumination of headlight.

articleTitle: Anti-Cheat in FPS Game for Aimbot Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Modern video games are becoming more complex day by day. Most of these modern games are multiplayer first-person shooter (FPS) games. The rising popularity of FPS games emphasizes the need to combat cheating for fair and enjoyable gaming.As the number of players using cheating techniques like aimbots, wallhacks, and speed hacks is also increasing, we need a way to detect players who are using cheating tools to gain an unfair advantage over regular players. For this system, we will be only focusing on aimbot cheat.Players who use aimbot cheats generally do not prioritize other aspects of the game. In our effort to distinguish between regular and cheating players, we will be identifying specific features encompassing time series data like aim velocity, number of shots, distance to target, and more, and also player’s behavioral data like utility usage, player movement and more. Utilizing these features, we aim to construct a server-side aimbot detection classifier named ’YAACS’. This classifier will comprise a parser, a deep learning model, and intermediary connection utilities designed for integration with the game server.The proposed system will yield a high classification accuracy while maintaining a low false positive rate.

articleTitle: Ensemble RDLR Architecture for Short-Term Solar Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Given the drastic shift of global sentiment towards renewable energy, it becomes incredibly important to match supply with demand. However the highly variable nature of weather makes it difficult to accurately predict the output of a solar power plant. Through this paper, we will approach this problem by using an ensemble model consisting of both machine learning and neural networks (NN) as base models to forecast the amount of energy that needs to be produced by a solar plant over a short-term time horizon, which in our case will be 0 minute (immediate), 5 minute, 30 minute and 90 minute. Each base model is fine tuned to encourage high diversity and low correlation to improve prediction accuracy. The expected stability or generalization from RF-DNN combined with the memory retention capability of the LSTM network should provide an ideal predictor for time series forecasting of a stochastic process like weather.

articleTitle: Land Ocean Mask Generation Using HAAR Transform on VH intensity band of SAR Sentinel -1 C-Band Polarimetry Image
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Our work proposes a novel approach to generate mask for land and ocean surface using multi Scale and multi resolution decomposition of SAR Image using wavelet Transform, later a threshold is determined for segmentation of SAR images for ocean and land mask generation. Our work generates land ocean mask from VH Intensity band of C-band SAR sentinel-1 Images. Morphological filtering methods are also applied to suppress noisy data and create a continuous outline of mask. Result is also analyzed by overlaying on Google Map visually.

articleTitle: Demand & Cost Driven Transportation Planning for Multi-Product Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This research article provides a comprehensive review of the multidirectional transportation problem, which is a more realistic representation of transportation flows in supply chains. While traditional supply chain flows are typically unidirectional, with supplier nodes and demander nodes, resulting in a forward flow of materials/goods from higher tier suppliers (upstream) to the end-consumer (downstream). The multidirectional transportation problem highlights the fact that each location within the network can act as both a supplier and a demander at a given time. Therefore, there is no such upstream to downstream flow. According to the demand of each location, all other locations can supply materials/goods to the deficit location. By acknowledging the locations, it can serve both as suppliers and demanders, the multidirectional transportation problem captures the complexities and interdependencies within supply chains more accurately. After that, a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model is applied to find the optimal solutions for the distribution decisions. Additionally, the paper includes a comparative analysis of various solvers to evaluate the performance of the optimization engine. This analysis provides a comprehensive understanding of the strengths and weaknesses of different solvers, helping to identify the most suitable approach for solving multidirectional transportation problems.

articleTitle: Review on Electrical Load Forecasting Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The review paper delves into the realm of Electrical Load Forecasting Techniques through a comprehensive literature review. These forecasts hold immense significance for utilities as they aid in planning power generation, capacity building, load management strategies such as switching, shedding, flows, and sharing. It is no wonder that this area of study has garnered significant attention over the last two decades. Multiple techniques have been proposed and explored, leading to a continuously growing research sphere. From simple statistical methods to advanced artificial intelligence models, the fundamentals have evolved over time. The study presents a chronological overview of the relevant literature, with a comparative analysis that justifies the trends in technique evolution. The study delves comparative study of conventional and modern method of Electrical load forecasting, conventional studies are Time Series Analysis, Regression Analysis, Artificial Neural Network (ANNs), Exponential Smoothing, Simulation Model for Electrical load Forecasting and Load Profile Analysis. Modern methods such as Machine Learning and Deep Learning, Advanced Time Series Analysis, Smart Grid Data, Adaptive Models, Model Stacking.This literature review will benefit the readers to get a comprehensive overview of previous studies. In later section the recent advancements in machine learning applications for load forecasting is emphasized. For better understanding comprehensive study are tabulated based on the used technologies with specific models and on their strengths and challenges.This analysis provides valuable insights into how these methods perform in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: AI-Based Heart Disease Detection Models improved the accuracy rate of diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Heart disease (HD) is the most dangerous chronic disease which takes thousands of lives every year throughout the world. The cases of HD patients rise every year due to the unhealthy lifestyle of human beings. So, in this scenario, an accurate and efficient technique is required for the early detection of the disease and for providing proper treatment to the patient at the right time. The advancement of artificial intelligence significantly raises the standard of living. Early disease detection in particular can save lives. The main objective of the research paper is to use the patient's medical history, we developed a heart disease prediction system to determine if a patient suffers from heart disease or not. To forecast and categorize the patient with heart disease, we employed two different machine learning methods such as artificial neural network (ANN) and random forest (RF). Among these two models, ANN gives the best prediction accuracy of 98.5%, F1-score of 0.99, and AUC of 99.6% respectively compared to the RF model having accuracy, F1-score, and AUC of 85.47,83.12 and 95.1 respectively. For the experimental work python open-source software is used. Using the Erbil heart disease dataset of cardiac patients, the proposed ANN architecture has improved the accuracy rate of HD classification to 98.5% compared with the existing methods. Therefore, this approach might be incorporated into the healthcare IoT ecosystem.

articleTitle: Authenticating Signals Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Signal authentication is an important frontier in the rapid evolution of digital security. This research explores the integration of machine learning and steganography techniques and highlights their important role in improving signal authentication. Machine learning algorithms enable the system to identify complex patterns in signals, making accurate identification possible. At the same time, steganography can hide authentication information in symbols, thus improving information integrity and confidentiality. This next article provides a review of the recent developments, classification and evaluation of various machine learning algorithms along with steganography techniques. It covers application areas such as cybersecurity, biometric authentication, and multimedia communications, showing successes and challenges. Topics such as counterterrorism, moral intervention and timely action were discussed during the discussions. By providing a perspective, this study informs researchers, practitioners and policy makers about the latest technology and how to build a future with powerful, flexible and safe lighting for the digital age.

Author Keywords: fusion of machine learning and steganography

articleTitle: A Secure Data Sharing and Authorized Searchable Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In the evolving landscape of e-healthcare, where patients increasingly benefit from secure sharing of their encrypted Personal Healthcare Records (PHRs) with healthcare professionals and research institutions, two pressing challenges emerge: the conflict between robust privacy protection and efficient data retrieval within encrypted PHRs, and the impractical demand for constant online presence from medical practitioners. In response, this abstract introduces DSAS, a pioneering and secure proxy searchable re-encryption scheme. DSAS enhances privacy and confidentiality by encrypting healthcare records before transmission, grants authorized access exclusively to trusted healthcare professionals and accredited research institutions, and empowers primary healthcare providers to delegate tasks securely. Security remains paramount, with formalized security definitions and rigorous testing, while the scheme's efficiency reaffirms its role as a catalyst for seamlessly integrating privacy, security, and efficiency within the e-healthcare domain, promising to revolutionize the landscape of remote PHR monitoring and research.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Detection through Integrated Spectral Analysis and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases are a global health concern that require prompt diagnosis in order to effectively treat. This study suggests a comprehensive method for detecting heart conditions from electrocardiogram (ECG) readings. In this study, we present an innovative approach that seamlessly integrates spectral analysis and deep learning techniques, augmented by feature fusion, to elevate the accuracy and efficiency of cardiovascular disease detection. The deep learning module incorporates a U-Net architecture, renowned for its efficacy in semantic segmentation tasks, to enhance the spatial localization of relevant features within the spectral data. The presented methodology, with its innovative integration of U-Net and KNN techniques, opens avenues for advancements in medical diagnostics, offering a harmonious blend of signal processing and deep learning to enhance healthcare outcomes. Keywords: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals, Fused net model, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm, U-Net architecture.

articleTitle: Optimizing Image Quality and Information Content with NSCT -PCNN Fusion for Medical and Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Multimodal image fusion is essential in many areas like medical imaging, remote sensing, as well as surveillance. Image fusion is the method of merging several images obtained from different sensors or modalities, resulting in a composite image with enriched information compared to individual input images. The classification of image fusion techniques comprises spatial domain fusion and frequency domain fusion. The objective of image fusion is to optimize the quality, clarity, and informative content of the resultant image. This work proposes a multimodal medical image fusion algorithm and a remote sensing image fusion algorithm. For decomposition of two input images, we employed Non-Subsampled Contourlet Transform (NSCT) for remote sensing images and Non-Subsampled Shearlet Transform (NSST) for medical images. Incorporating these two decomposition techniques, input images broken down into LF and HF sub-bands, and facilitating the extraction of features across multiple directions. For the fusion of these LF and HF sub-bands, PCNN based fusion rule is used. Dual-Channel Pulse Coupled Neural Network (DCPCNN) is employed for its better fusion effect. Using the resultant integrated image, diagnosis, and environmental monitoring can be done precisely and also helps in reducing storage space for preserving multiple images. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the suggested algorithms perform in their applications and attains promising results.

articleTitle: Colorization Of Grey Scale Images
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: "Colorization is the process of adding color to grayscale images, aiming to create visually appealing and authentic results. Recently, significant advancements have been made in colorization techniques, ranging from labor-intensive, user-dependent methods to complex automated approaches. This field combines machine learning, deep learning, and artistic creativity. Image colorization assigns colors to pixels in grayscale images and can be categorized into three methods: scribble-based, example-based, and learning-based. Scribble-based colorization requires substantial user effort to provide detailed scribbles on target images. Example-based methods transfer color from a reference image to the target, but finding a suitable reference can be challenging. Learning-based methods use a neural network to colorize images automatically. The proposed method segments grayscale images into super pixels, extracts features, and propagates color information efficiently. Experimental results show the proposed algorithms outperform existing methods, demonstrating superior accuracy and efficiency in various applications".

articleTitle: An Approach for Measuring Unstructured text Document Similarity using LDA-BERT Embedding Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This research work proposes an innovative method for measuring text similarity of unstructured PDF documents using a hybrid approach that combines Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) embedding models. The proposed methodology initially employs LDA to extract topic distributions from the documents and subsequently employs BERT to create contextualized embeddings of these topics. These resulting embeddings are then utilized to compute similarity scores between pairs of pdf documents.To assess the effectiveness of the proposed approach, experiments are conducted using a diverse datasets of scientific research papers, legal documents, and news articles. Our findings reveal that the proposed method surpasses conventional techniques such as Cosine similarity and Jaccard similarity in terms of accuracy and robustness. Notably, our approach demonstrates exceptional performance in detecting cases of plagiarism, particularly when the plagiarized content has been rephrased or paraphrased.Overall, this research underscores the potential of the LDA-BERT embedding model to enhance the precision and efficiency of text similarity measurements, with wide-ranging applications across document analysis, plagiarism detection, and information retrieval.

articleTitle: Super -Resolution Performance: A Comparative Analysis of SRGAN and ESRGAN Techniques for Single Image Restoration
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks have achieved remarkable progress in enhancing the resolution of single images with high accuracy and speed. However, the primary challenge is to recover finer texture details when super-resolving the images. Optimization-based super-resolution methods have aimed to minimize MSRE, which often sacrifices perceptual quality and high-frequency characteristics in favor of high PSNR. This paper presents a comparative analysis of two prominent SISR techniques, SRGAN and ESRGAN, focusing on their performance metrics and visual quality. SRGAN employs a GAN architecture, which uses a perceptual loss function to generate photorealistic 4x upscaled images of natural images with improved visual appeal. However, SRGAN might introduce artifacts like patterns around high-frequency details, impacting image quality. To further enhance visual quality, ESRGAN, an enhanced variant of SRGAN, is employed, which introduces improvements in its architecture and loss function to overcome the limitations of SRGAN. ESRGAN is renowned for its ability to produce higher-quality visual output than SRGAN, with more realistic and natural textures. The quality of images generated by both SRGAN and ESRGAN is assessed using quantitative metrics, including Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM).

articleTitle: Evaluating Text Generation Confidence: A Pseudo Confidence Metric for Completion Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In the world of Generative models, numerous industries have progressively adopted generative AI to address their business challenges. The businesses place great importance on achieving precise outcomes and demand accuracy in generated results, thus the establishment of benchmark metrics is necessary, and the metrics should convey confidence in the prediction. However, a significant obstacle is validating the effectiveness of the results because of the absence of the definitive ground truth labels for validation purposes. To overcome the obstacle of absence of true labels in text completion models, this research presents a unique approach for quantitative prediction analysis. Our method leverages the log probabilities associated with each token of the generated text and considers both variation in token probabilities and deviation from the most probable token. By focusing on the top five most probable tokens, our metric effectively calculates a pseudo-confidence score, providing industries with a reliable measure of confidence in generative AI models. This novel metric contributes to the advancement of generative AI validation methods, enabling businesses to have greater confidence in the application of generative models for various challenges.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Connectivity and Mobility for the Advancements in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks for Modern Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The rapid evolution of modern communication and transportation systems has brought forth numerous challenges, ranging from traffic congestion to safety concerns. Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) represent a promising technology that leverages the capabilities of intelligent communication between vehicles to address these challenges. This paper explores advanced VANET solutions designed to overcome the obstacles inherent in contemporary communication and transportation systems. The challenges addressed include dynamic traffic conditions, limited bandwidth, security and privacy issues, and the need for seamless integration with emerging technologies. Advanced VANETs incorporate cutting-edge features such as 5G connectivity, machine learning algorithms, and cooperative intelligence to enhance the efficiency, safety, and overall performance of vehicular networks. The proposed solutions encompass intelligent traffic management algorithms that adapt to changing road conditions in real-time, ensuring optimal routes and reducing congestion. Additionally, the integration of 5G technology enhances communication reliability and enables the transmission of large volumes of data, supporting applications such as video streaming and real-time traffic updates. Security and privacy concerns are addressed through advanced encryption techniques and secure authentication mechanisms, ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of communication within the VANET. Furthermore, machine learning algorithms are employed for predictive analytics, enabling vehicles to anticipate potential hazards and proactively take preventive measures. The synergy between VANETs and emerging technologies forms a robust foundation for the development of adaptive and responsive transportation systems. This paper provides insights into the design, implementation, and benefits of advanced VANET solutions, contributing to the ongoing discourse on the future of intelligent transportation systems. The proposed advancements hold the potential to revolutionize modern communication and transportation, paving the way for safer, more efficient, and seamlessly connected vehicular networks.

articleTitle: Music generation using hybrid deep neural model
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Music theory is at the core of music. Whenever artists create any new songs it takes a long time to think and generate them and sometimes the music still comes out bad. The point of music generation using AI is that previous successful and melodious music can be used to generate new and inspired music by it. And with the help of this professional musicians can create better music faster. The paper is about building a model that creates music automatically using datasets containing music from different artists and genres. It learns the pattern of music in the datasets and generate new music inspired from those. For this, we are utilizing the knowledge of basic music representation like the ABC notation and midi format. We are implementing hybrid deep learning neural model using Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long short-term memory (LSTM).

articleTitle: Hardware Efficient Realization of 128 bit Advanced Encryption Standard in FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In the current digital world, data security is a top concern. With the aid of current standards, text and image data are typically well safeguarded. However, voice communications security remains a difficult challenge. The issue of data security is becoming more pressing as technology continues to progress. The hackers may breach any security system since they have access to cutting-edge new tools and methods. As a result, concerns over data security are growing. Either software or hardware implementations are used to secure data. Because Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) are more efficient, flexible, and less complex than other hardware implementation methods, they are used in this paper. The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm, one of the security methods, is the main subject of this work's hardware implementation. This encryption technique is adaptable and is employed in military settings. The original 128-bit plain text can be recovered using the same key for decryption. The non-LUT based implementation of AES S-box and inverse S-box is the preferable method for high-speed applications. The Quartus-II 9.1 program software is used to run the AES algorithm. In this paper AES algorithm's design implementation and the resources used to implement it on FPGA are covered.

articleTitle: Assessment of Real time Scheduling Strategies on RTOS
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of well-known real time schedulers, Earliest Deadline First (EDF) and the Rate Monotonic (RM) schedulers with the objective to evaluate their performance and suitability for real-time embedded applications on FreeRTOS. Synthetic tasks were developed to simulate real-world scenarios. Performance metrics, including average wait time, number of context switches, and CPU utilization, are then employed to assess the effectiveness of the schedulers. Results demonstrate that EDF outperforms RM in terms of deadline miss ratio, particularly under high system load. EDF also tends to minimize average wait time; however, it may result in a higher number of context switches. In contrast, RM exhibits higher average wait time but generally has fewer context switches. It is noteworthy that the difference between EDF and RM becomes less significant for periodic tasks with deadlines equal to their period, thereby increasing the performance dependability on the total number of tasks that are to be scheduled. The findings aim to assist system designers in making informed decisions when selecting a suitable scheduling algorithm for their real-time applications.

articleTitle: Analyzing the intricacies of McCabe's complexity over a span of four to five decades
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: McCabe’scyclomatic complexity is a software measurement matrix used in white box testing. It is a measurement of complexity of a program. It is also used as standard for analysis of two program codes or we can say it is a metric counts a number of arranged in straight not dependent paths through a bit of code. The purpose of the paper is to analyze cyclomatic complexity in different programs and how can we improve this in future the proposed solution is we should use Machine learning algo to calculate Mccabes cyclomatic complexity. The cyclomatic complexity is calculated using the flow chart of the code. Based on the flow chart how to find cyclomatic complexity and limitations of complexity is explained here.

articleTitle: Crafting Connections: Empowering Kondapalli Artisans through a Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Handicrafts hold historical significance in representing the essence of our nation's native culture. However, these handcrafted goods still need to be explored globally, and the manufacturers frequently need help connecting directly with larger markets and potential customers. The scope of this project is bound to Kondapalli Toys, also known as Kondapalli Bommalu, renowned wooden handicrafts originating from Andhra Pradesh, India. The current resources for resolving this issue are not easily available on the market, and there is a lack of a user-friendly application. A dedicated Android application is needed to strengthen the handicraft business. This application enables artisans and potential customers to communicate effortlessly, guaranteeing secure transactions, offering valuable data insights, and providing resources for skill and capacity development. The user interface for this application was developed using the Flutter framework, which prioritizes data security and is scalable and region-adaptive. Through this application, manufacturers can conveniently reach markets while customers have the opportunity to explore and connect with their businesses, allowing them to display their craft items to a global audience.

articleTitle: Enhanced Stock Market Prediction: Integration of PCA with Random Forest Classifiers for Complex Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Stock market is a time series model in the financial domain. The fluctuations of the financial market are dynamic, selective, nonlinear, non-stationary and noisy. It is hard to make predictions from the principle of efficient market hypothesis since the stock price will follow a random work pattern. There are many factors that lead to the rise and fall of financial market movement. Public opinion and news play a vital role in market movements especially after the Game Stop short squeeze. Prediction of a stock price using artificial intelligence and machine learning looks promising as it considers all the factors affecting the volatility of the market. Statistical analysis methods stand a good chance at finding the main factor that impacts the short-term stock volatility. Retail investors have an active part to play in investments and pursuing their movements help quantify predictions better. A new proposed model will be used, which involves a combination of social sentiment data retrieved from Twitter and historical Open High Low Close (OHLC) data. The data will be processed through two different Machine Learning models and correlated with statistical analysis, leading to high accuracy results.

articleTitle: "Spy – Rover" – An IoT based Surveillance Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Surveillance is observing or tracking for the sole purpose of data collection. It is used by humans in almost any domain that requires the gathering of data and information. The present work represents the designing of an IoT-based surveillance ROVER using the ESP32-CAM AI-Thinker module which helps in real time video monitoring. It can lead to a huge application in different sectors like defence, business, game, intelligence gathering, monitoring, maintenance, etc. Also, it can be used in rescue operations and spying through a narrow passage. The prototype of the robot consists of a rocker-bogey suspension that can traverse through almost any type of terrain and a body in which different types of electronic components and sensors are mounted for gathering data which will be transferred over IoT to the control unit ESP32 using WSN (Wireless Sensor Network).

articleTitle: Network Initialization and Topology Creation in Wireless Sensor Networks: Architectural Insights and Round-Based Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This study looks at the challenges of optimizing energy consumption and improving clustering efficacy in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). The research begins with a thorough review of the literature, summarizing existing models and methodologies while highlighting their limitations. The proposed methodology introduces a novel framework for WSNs by combining an improved clustering model with Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) optimization and Deep Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) decision-making. The network architecture is established during the initialization phase, which assigns random coordinates to nodes within specified yard dimensions. During the network creation phase, the topology is generated and network operation is simulated across rounds. The clustering phase employs selected models, employing ABC optimization to identify Cluster Heads (CHs) and Deep LSTM for learning and decision-making. Calculations of energy dissipation take into account both CHs and non-CHs, as well as factors such as distance to the sink and data transmission. The results and visualization phase updates and plots metrics such as packets sent, dead nodes, and energy consumption, revealing network performance. Preliminary findings demonstrate the potential of the proposed method.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Analysis of Unsteady Convection in Copper-Water Nanofluid Flow over a Vertically Moving Porous Plate
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The dynamic behaviour of unsteady convection in a copper-water nanofluid, wherein a vertically moving porous plate serves as the medium for heat transfer. The study leverages artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to enhance the understanding of the complex fluid dynamics and thermal characteristics involved in this scenario. The application of AI algorithms facilitates a comprehensive analysis of the nanofluid's behavior, allowing for more accurate predictions and insights into the heat transfer processes. The results contribute to the advancement of both nanofluid dynamics and AI applications in fluid mechanics, offering valuable information for engineering and technological advancements. This study examines MHD convective flow over a perpendicular porous plate using Laplace transforms. Analytical evaluation and computational discussion of temperature, velocity, Nusselt number, and shear stress reveal engineering tool applications. Velocity rises with permeability, and stress elevates with magnetic parameters.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Classifying Bearing Failures Using Time and Frequency Domain Features
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Amongst the most crucial components of rotating machinery, bearings failure rate is high and it can directly impact the efficiency of the complete piece of machinery. As a result, diagnosing bearing faults is crucial because it can help ensure running stability and upkeep, boosting production efficiency and economic gains. The objective of the study is to evaluate various machine learning algorithms to find out the best method for categorizing bearing failure into three types: (a) Normal bearing, (b) Inner race fault (c) Outer race fault. The raw vibration signal is processed to obtain the temporal and frequency domain information. The classification is obtained using the MFPT dataset of rolling bearings. To evaluate the classification accuracy receiver operating characteristics (ROC) is employed as a performance metric. The classification models are compared: K-nearest neighbor, Support Vector Machine, Neural Network, and Ensemble. The Ensemble subspace KNN and Cubic SVM algorithms are proven to be the most effective among other algorithms. The cubic SVM has shown better accuracy with shorter training times. The dataset of normal bearing and the faults (inner race and outer race) were compared for the time domain and frequency domain analysis. According to the study, it is found that power spectrum-frequency domain parameters and time domain parameter kurtosis show major variations amongst the normal and the faulty bearings.

articleTitle: Specie Mapping Based on Water Quality Index Using Supervised Machine Learning and Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Data collection and study of water quality has been important in terms of understanding the physical, chemical, and biological qualities of water. These parameters can be studied discriminately depending on the requirements as per industry and economic standards. In this paper, the work has been expanded further into the domain of Species Mapping. The datasets of various Indian rivers were collected for multiple parameters like Temperature, Dissolved Oxygen, Conductivity, Biochemical Oxygen Demand, pH, Nitrate-N, Fecal Coli Form, Total Coli Form and then processed using Artificial Neural Network data modelling technique. The model is then trained to derive outputs that map to the various aquatic species having a tolerant environment based on similar parameters.

Author Keywords: Feed Forward Back Propagation Neural Network

articleTitle: Effect of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) on Pedestrian Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The potential of ADAS to improve road safety and minimise accidents has garnered a lot of interest in recent years. Although ADAS have largely been studied for their potential benefits to motorists, it is crucial that we also examine their potential effects on pedestrians. The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect that ADAS technologies have on pedestrian safety by looking at their individual parts, their implementation in automobiles, and the pros and cons of using them. To evaluate the impact of ADAS on pedestrian safety, the researchers combined statistical analysis with field studies and simulations.

articleTitle: Vertical Farming: A Catalyst for Economic Growth and Resilience
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Vertical farming, an innovative agricultural practice, has garnered attention not only for its potential to address food security and environmental concerns but also for its significant impact on economic development. This paper explores the multifaceted ways in which vertical farming contributes to economic growth, job creation, market expansion, and resilience in the face of global challenges. Through an analysis of economic indicators, case studies, and industry trends, this paper elucidates the transformative role of vertical farming in shaping the economic landscape of the 21st century.

articleTitle: An IoT device for Railway Loop Line Changer with Auto Feedback and Signalling
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The Railway Loop Line Changer with Automatic Feedback and Signalling project presents an automated solution for optimizing railway operations. Employing limit switches to detect loop change status, a servo motor WS2812 lights for visual indicators, and a buzzer for error alerts, the system targets the efficient execution of loop line changes. As a train approaches, the servo motor dynamically repositions the tracks, with limit switches providing crucial feedback. visualcues and audible alerts from the buzzer convey the success or failure of changes, ensuring real-time operator feedback. It improves Railway safety management.

articleTitle: CureQ, a medical chatbot to connect to Medical Practioners/Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In an age where technology is changing every aspect of our lives, CureQ is an innovative healthcare solution. This innovative healthcare chatbot acts as a bridge between users and healthcare practitioners, providing seamless communication with hospitals and healthcare providers. At the heart of CureQ is a sophisticated machine learning model: a decision tree classifier. This machine learning model is not only excellent at predicting diseases based on symptoms provided by users, but it goes one step further by providing detailed disease descriptions and disease evaluation methods. In addition to diagnostic capabilities, CureQ improves usability by enabling direct communication between users and healthcare professionals. The platform seamlessly integrates an appointment scheduling system, allowing users to book appointments with their preferred doctors based on their unique preferences

articleTitle: Exploring New Horizons in Real-Time Emotion Detection through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This study explores the field of emotion recognition using facial expressions, utilizing a new approach that showcases exceptional talents in comprehending and analyzing various emotional states. The suggested method utilizes datasets such as RAF-DB, ExpW, and Fer2013 to train in a planned manner, assuring a balanced distribution of instances across depression, non-depression, and neutral emotion categories. The focus on equilibrium boosts the algorithm's resilience, allowing it to effectively generalize over a wide range of emotional expressions. The study highlights the subtle and intricate process of identifying depression using facial recognition technology, underlining the importance of being careful and considerate when dealing with mental health assessments. Implementing facial recognition for mental health reasons necessitates prioritizing ethical considerations, obtaining user agreement, and safeguarding privacy. The proposed method, presented as an auxiliary instrument, necessitates cooperation with mental health experts to guarantee thorough evaluations and suitable assistance.

articleTitle: Optimizing Lung Cancer Detection Methodologies: A Comprehensive Systematic Review and the Development of PRECISE-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The study begins with a thorough literature review, which identifies gaps and challenges in current methodologies. The proposed methodology calls for systematic data collection, organization, and stratification into testing, validation, and training sets. An image processing pipeline is then implemented, which includes pre-processing techniques such as contrast enhancement and noise reduction. The segmentation stage employs advanced thresholding techniques, producing a segmented lung image. Subsequent multidimensional transformations produce a filtered image that highlights relevant characteristics. GLCM and HoG techniques are used to extract features, which are then integrated into neural networks for complex pattern recognition. A Multiclass Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier is then trained on the dataset to categorize lung cancers using the extracted features. Model evaluation, using metrics such as accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity, provides information about the model's performance. The study concludes with the provisional designation "PRECISE-Net," which reflects its predictive and classification abilities. Early results are promising, laying a solid foundation for future refinement and application in early lung cancer detection.

articleTitle: Infant Health Child Condition Based Phototherapy for Neonatal Jaundice Patient
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The wellbeing of new born is extremely important for parents. Many new born babies suffer from neonatal jaundice which may lead to death. A high level of bilirubin is one of the symptoms of neonatal jaundice in babies The present work is carried out to support and save lives of infants from neonatal jaundice. Around 25% and 60% of full-term babies and 80% of preterm babies experience jaundice in their first two weeks of life, respectively, and phototherapy is one of the most effective ways in modern medicine to manage this illness. The phototherapeutic approach converts bilirubin into water-soluble photo-products that can be excreted without passing through the hepatic conjugating system. Phototherapy uses ultraviolet light (UV) to lower blood bilirubin levels in infants. A system is developed here that can automatically control the intensity of UV light based on the severity of neonatal jaundice. The Arduino Uno and ESP32 are integrated into the neonatal jaundice phototherapy system. The healthcare providers enter bilirubin levels to start the Arduino Uno UV light control system. The ESP32 gathers essential information such as weight, temperature, and heart rate, generating an extensive dataset. Based on the infant's state, ESP32 uses this data to precisely customize the UV light treatment. Immediate insights are obtained through real-time feedback through a 16x2 LCD, and the complete dataset is safely transferred to the BLYNK IoT platform. The practitioner and parents can monitor the child development by using smartphone App.

articleTitle: HydroGuardian: Transformative Water Quality Supervision through IoT Advancements
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)

authors.preferredName: Mudunuri V C H S Raju

abstract: Water contamination has emerged as a widespread issue across the world. To ensure the utilization of pure water, it is indispensable to sustain ambient water quality. Fortunately, smart technology and solutions are available to address this issue. This paper will propose an effective IoT-based water quality measuring device that can detect and measure five parameters, namely pH, turbidity, TDS, conductivity, and salinity. The proposed system can test the required parameter values and provide the best quality value for each. This IoT-based device was developed using a microcontroller and a cloud platform. With this device, we can help address the issue of water pollution and provide people with access to pure water. The proposed system ensures that the water sample does not contain any harmful levels of nitrites/nitrates, chlorine, or hardness, and maintaining appropriate parameters is crucial for good health. In this proposed system, five parameters are to be measured by the system to calculate the quality of the entity like water and migrate the results to a microcontroller and a cloud platform to live monitor.

articleTitle: Smart Watches and Pulse Bands with Built-in Oximeter
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In the present day we live in, a catastrophic virus COVID-19 has drastically changed the day to day living of a human being. The virus causes hypoxemia (shortness of breath), sometimes even severe cases. Hypoxemia is caused due to low oxygen saturation (SpO2) levels and in order to monitor SpO2 levels we utilize the method of Pulse Oximetry. It has played a major role in monitoring oxygen levels in a continuous and accurate manner. Patients who are diagnosed during the early stages with the virus are able to monitor their SpO2 levels at home and take the prescribed medicines. This reduced the need for hospital beds and chaos during the pandemic as patients were able to self-isolate and monitor themselves. The principle that Oximetry is contingent on is light reflectance. The fingertip model is the most common technique used to display the blood oxygenation level. However, the finger model is not as comfortable and does not promote continuous monitoring of SpO2 levels. Factors such as nail polish can play a role in the accuracy of the reading. The proposed design is a non-invasive medical device that can measure the oxygen saturation level in a person’s blood. Wrist wearing is preferable to finger models as it is a comfortable site for measuring than that of the latter, therefore enabling continuous monitoring of oxygen saturation level. Most devices in application today are inaccurate and used for non-clinical use. Therefore, it is aimed to achieve better accuracy by avoiding readings that are influenced by factors such as motion artifacts by utilizing sensors that are appropriate through an accelerometer and gyroscope. The sensors have been utilized to its maximum potential as the model also detects heart rate levels. Providing device connectivity to the proposed wrist pulse oximeter through a Wi- Fi module has advanced its functionality by transmitting notifications that alert an individual with the levels of oxygen saturation, fall detection and heart rate levels.

articleTitle: An IoT based smart kitchen appliance to control and monitor exhaust system
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The Smart Exhaust product presents an innovative solution designed to address the complexities and high costs associated with traditional exhaust systems in professional kitchens. By focusing on a user-friendly design, the Smart Exhaust system not only simplifies installation and maintenance but also incorporates advanced technology for efficient ventilation and energy use. With features like automated controls and air quality sensors, it caters to a wide range of users, from novice to expert. Scalability and affordability are core components of this system, offering cost-effective manufacturing, flexible pricing, and suitability for various kitchen sizes. Emphasizing improved air quality and safety, the Smart Exhaust enhances the working environment while keeping operational noise to a minimum. Additionally, environmentally conscious aspects such as energy-efficient operation and the use of sustainable materials highlight its commitment to reducing the carbon footprint. The Smart Exhaust product holds significant market potential, with its adaptability to different culinary traditions and the possibility of integration with other smart kitchen technologies, paving the way for a more accessible, efficient, and safer kitchen environment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Analysis of Free Convection Flow through a Porous Medium in a Third-Grade Vertical Channel: A Comprehensive Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The analysis of fully developed unfixed convection in a vertical channel with a third-grade fluid and porous medium involves solving complex nonlinear equations for speed and temperature fields. To augment this process, machine learning techniques offer valuable contributions. Machine learning algorithms facilitate the creation of predictive models, extracting insights from extensive data, optimizing parameters for efficiency, and conducting sensitivity analyses to understand system responses. Furthermore, these algorithms aid in reducing computational costs through surrogate models and metamodels, recognizing intricate patterns, and enabling real-time monitoring and control for adaptive strategies. By integrating machine learning, the study benefits from enhanced prediction accuracy, data-driven decision-making, and a deeper comprehension of the intricate dynamics governing fluid flow and temperature distribution in the vertical channel.

articleTitle: Transition from Traditional to Agile Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In the continually evolving realm of project management, organizations are increasingly recognizing the limitations of traditional methodologies such as Waterfall and gravitating toward Agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban. This transition signifies a profound philosophical shift in project management, impacting not only project execution but also the culture and dynamics within organizations. The transition to Agile methodology brings about several significant changes and outcomes. Foremost, Agile methodologies place a premium on flexibility and adaptability. Teams gain the capacity to swiftly respond to evolving requirements and customer feedback, nurturing a dynamic project environment. This flexibility stands in stark contrast to the inflexibility often inherent in traditional methodologies, where project plans are rigidly set. Agile methodologies are celebrated for their ability to expedite project delivery. Through incremental and iterative development, Agile facilitates the prompt delivery of valuable features and functionality, enhancing the project's responsiveness to market shifts. Additionally, Agile's customer-centric approach centers on continuous customer feedback, ensuring that the final product aligns closely with customer expectations, ultimately leading to heightened satisfaction.Quality assurance represents another area where Agile methodologies excel. Thorough testing and quality checks are integral to Agile, resulting in an overall higher product quality. By identifying and addressing issues early in the development cycle, Agile minimizes the risk of costly errors and rework.One of the most significant advantages of transitioning to Agile is the effective mitigation of project risks. Agile divides projects into smaller, manageable components, facilitating early risk identification and targeted mitigation strategies. In contrast, traditional methodologies may leave risks undiscovered until late in the project, resulting in costly setbacks.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Thyroid Tumor Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Thyroid tumors and disorders are serious health concerns and the necessity for accurate diagnostic procedures are required. In this paper, we are going to build a model that predicts thyroid tumors using ultrasonic images and classifies them into three categories – benign, malignant, and normal thyroid. Using a large dataset of ultrasonic images, we employ deep learning techniques for Restnet101-based feature extraction and pattern recognition. Through examining and cross–validating, we improve the model’s performance and aim for high accuracy in categorizing between benign, malignant, and normal thyroid conditions and predicting the nodules. We implemented Resnet 101 which is a Convolutional neural network along with a training function to stop the iterations when there is no change in validation and training values to avoid overfitting and to reduce the time complexity. Our findings demonstrate that the model can efficiently aid doctors in making accurate diagnostic decisions, minimizing the need for invasive treatments, and improving patient outcomes. We Successfully deployed a model with an accuracy of 0.93 and Customised CNN having 4 layers with an accuracy of 0.873.

articleTitle: Exploring New Frontiers in Cervical Cancer Detection: A Survey and Preliminary Framework Results
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This study provides a comprehensive survey and proposes a novel framework for detecting cervical cancer through image analysis, focusing on the stages from initialization to edge detection. The survey component provides an in-depth examination of existing methodologies, emphasizing the challenges and advancements in cervix cancer detection. The proposed framework consists of ten major steps, beginning with Initialization and Setup, where parameters for cervical cancer detection are configured. Following that, image selection, pre-processing, segmentation, and edge detection are performed using techniques such as the Median Filter, binary conversion, and the Canny edge detection algorithm. The framework combines traditional and deep learning techniques, including the use of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for complex feature extraction. To categorize images into Normal, Benign, or Malignant classes, the classification stage employs k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) and Support Vector Machines (SVM). Eventually, this paper provides a survey of cervical cancer detection methodologies as well as an introduction to a robust framework that includes critical steps from initialization to edge detection. The results show that the proposed framework is effective at improving image quality and extracting relevant features for accurate classification, contributing to the advancement of cervical cancer detection methods.

articleTitle: SEO Indexing Strategies for Physiotherapy Services in Healthcare- Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This research explores the pivotal role of Search Engine Optimization (SEO) in boosting the online visibility of healthcare services, particularly physiotherapy. The primary focus is on the importance of effective indexing in this process. As patients increasingly turn to search engines to find medical facilities, including physiotherapy providers, the need for proper indexing becomes evident. This study highlights the tactical and technical aspects of indexing, emphasizing its significance within SEO. The paper commences with an overview of physiotherapy’s value in healthcare and the fundamental principles of SEO. It underscores how indexing ensures that site content is accessible to search engine crawlers. Moreover, the study delves into the value of keyword research and content optimization for physiotherapy. Aligning content with patient demands and queries can enhance the likelihood of prominent search engine placement.Offering practical guidance, this paper draws from real-world case studies and market trends to assist physiotherapy practitioners and clinic owners in improving their online presence. The methods and tactics discussed aim to expand the reach of medical professionals, ultimately increasing access to physiotherapy services. In conclusion, the research underscores the critical role of indexing in SEO and its implications for physiotherapy services. By implementing indexing best practices, physiotherapy providers can bolster their online presence, connect with more patients, and contribute to healthcare accessibility in the digital age.

articleTitle: Silent Conversations: A Deep Dive into using CNN and ChatGPT for deriving meaning from Language Gestures
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: For the community who are deaf or hard of hearing, sign language serves as a major means of communication. However, their inability to properly communicate is frequently hampered by a lack of resources and qualified translators. Computer vision and image processing methods, such as Convolutional Neural Networks, a more recent advancement in the field of computer vision, can be utilized to address this problem. The aim of translating sign language is to enable communication between those who are deaf and those who are hearing by precisely identifying, categorizing, and analyzing the hand motions used in sign language. To close the communication gap, this project attempts to develop a technology that can automatically convert Indian sign language into Textual Context. Using techniques like CNN for image classification and generative AI (ChatGPT) for sentence formation, which are techniques and tools known for their high degree of accuracy, we can develop an effective solution.

articleTitle: Power Output Variation of a Photovoltaic (PV) Module Mounted on an Electric Vehicle (EV)
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The research delves into assessing how fluctuations in power output from a photovoltaic (PV) module, affixed to an electric vehicle (EV), impact overall performance. Employing a blend of empirical data and mathematical models, the investigation scrutinizes the PV module’s behavior across diverse environmental scenarios and during vehicle mobility. The results indicate that the power output fluctuations of the PV module integrated into an EV are minimal compared to the influences of vehicle motion and environmental factors. Taking all factors into account, it can be inferred that integrating PV modules into EVs holds substantial promise for mitigating greenhouse gas emissions and enhancing the overall energy efficiency of transportation.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Brain Tumor Classification: A Dual-Focus Review and Framework Development
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This research paper functions as both a framework initiation and a dual-purpose review by outlining an all-encompassing methodology for the progression of brain tumor classification systems. The research progresses in a methodical sequence of phases, commencing with the procurement of a wide range of annotated MRI scans from the BRATS database, which demonstrates a dedication to utilizing empirical data. The following image pre-processing consists of resizing, color mapping, and filtering, among other operations, with the objective of standardizing and improving the quality of the images. Methods for feature extraction and thresholding, such as GLCM, HoG, and LBP, identify the unique signatures of brain lesions. ML/DL models, including CNNs for DL and SVM or NB for ML, are constructed and trained on annotated datasets, which enables the implementation of multi-class classification. The methodology produces clinically pertinent data by integrating pre-processing, feature extraction, and model training. Subsequently, a thorough performance evaluation is conducted to assess the accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity of the models. By utilizing performance evaluations to guide an iterative development process, the model's robustness and generalizability are strengthened, thereby increasing its potential for efficacy in a wide range of clinical scenarios. By employing this all-encompassing methodology, progress is anticipated in the classification of brain tumors, laying the groundwork for enhanced clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: IoT Object Based Product SortingMachine
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The fruit and confectionery sorting industries both use Object Based Sorting extensively. This system presents an image processing approach for object detection and item sorting. The candies are sorted into certain bin baskets using a process once they have been detected. Here, we show how this system works with a camera that has an electronic circuit and three bins for sorting. To accomplish this, the system connects a Raspberry Pi to a controller circuit. A camera that is affixed to the controller circuit allows it to detect little objects in front of it. An object is fed into the camera chamber by means of a motor. The sorter receives a signal as soon as the object is detected. system that positions the sorting tube toward the appropriate portion using a motor. After that, the object is pushed toward the tubs by a feeder to be sorted, and the feeder pulls in the subsequent object. To maintain track of the quantity of objects sorted in each segment, the action data are transmitted to the IOT server via the iotgecko platform. This allows us to create an IOT sorting system that is fully automated.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Onboard Charger for Hybrid Electric Vehicles using ANN Based Current Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: An Artificial Neural Network-based voltage ripple controller and battery charging circuit evaluation are presented in this paper (ANN). A single-phase bidirectional on-board charger (OBC) is linked to a permanent magnet alternator and its inverter to charge the batteries of plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEVs). High-efficiency vehicles use intricate power electronics. By linking power relays to the generator drive mechanism, the suggested circuit might potentially charge batteries. By doing this way with conventional OBCs, power density in automobiles may be enhanced. After ANN calculates the ripple in the output voltage, the power converter may modify the system frequency in response to variations in load. Therefore, the system is conditioned to respond to a non-linear change in the load, and the ripple voltage at the output may be maintained within an acceptable range by frequency regulation. The computing performance allows for around a week of parametric simulation time. The ANN model avoids the time consumption and resources required for circuit simulations, relying instead on statistics. The output voltage ripple estimated with the ANN model was confirmed to be accurate by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Price Recommendation For E-Commerce Using ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In online commerce, pricing decisions play a critical role in determining the success and profitability of businesses, Leveraging advanced machine learning algorithms and robust data analytics, the system analyzes diverse parameters including historical sales data, market trends, competitor pricing strategies, and customer behavior patterns. By integrating these multifaceted insights, the system generates dynamic and data- driven price recommendations. These recommendations empower online sellers to optimize pricing strategies, strike a balance between competitiveness and profitability, and cater to evolving market demands. The project aims to create an algorithm for automatic price suggestions in E-commerce, leveraging user-inputted text descriptions, product category details, brand information, and item conditions. The objective is to enhance the user experience by providing pricing guidance to both sellers and buyers on an online platform. Using a supervised learning approach, the project focuses on predicting optimal product prices, employing regression models evaluated using Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). Additionally, considering the potential impact of user-related features like location, gender, and login information, the study explores their influence on pricing accuracy. By Preprocess multilingual text data, facilitating better language recognition and categorization for more accurate pricing suggestions. The project's outcomes aim to improve transactional efficiency within the E-commerce domain by providing users with informed pricing insights before making purchasing or selling decisions.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection: A Convolutional Neural Network based Approach for Robust Benign and Malignant Mass Identification Across Varied Breast Density
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This paper presents a groundbreaking methodology for the identification of breast cancer using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) that has been specifically engineered to exhibit resilience in accurately distinguishing between benign and malignant masses in X-ray images. By effectively utilizing a meticulously curated dataset comprising 5040 images sourced from Kaggle, wherein each category is represented by an equal distribution of 2520 images, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) attains a commendable training accuracy of 84.13%. The remarkable ability of the model to discern intricate patterns among diverse breast densities is truly commendable, as it effectively tackles a crucial facet of breast cancer detection. During the testing process, it is noteworthy that the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) consistently upholds a commendable level of accuracy, specifically measuring 75.92%. This outcome serves as a testament to the efficacy of CNN in real-world scenarios. This study highlights the inherent capacity of this convolutional neural network (CNN)-derived methodology as a potent instrument for the timely identification of breast cancer, presenting a promising pathway towards enhanced precision in diagnosis and, ultimately, better prognoses for patients.

articleTitle: Future Perspectives in Wireless Body Area Network and Its Applications-A Supplementary Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This paper surveys the concerns, application areas, findings, and performance challenges related to modern technology wireless communication. It discusses how wireless body area networks are involved in different applications such as remote healthcare monitoring, assisted living, telemedicine, sports, military, life style and environment applications. highlights the various issues that occur in WBAN technology. As the demand for ubiquitous networks has increased, there has been an increase in interest in the creation of wireless short-range communication devices for the home, office, and other information devices. The rapid development of standards and techniques for pervasive networks has propelled the technology into the global market.

articleTitle: A Survey of Music Recommendations based on Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: A person's whole mood and well-being can be improved by using music as a potent therapeutic technique. Furthermore, it is common knowledge that music affects people's moods and emotions greatly and plays a crucial part in daily life. In order to understand the user's mood and sentiments and provide them an opportunity to express themselves, the study proposes an emotion-based music recommendation system that would be employed in a journaling application.The application analyzes the text and classifies the emotions of its entries using the Bi-LSTM model in order to assist users in keeping track of their emotional state. The emotions gathered are converted into first recommendations using a content-based recommendation system, then more recommendations are given depending on the preferences of the users.

articleTitle: Exploring the Effectiveness of OpenCV in Face Recognition for Student Attendance
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Automatic face recognition (AFR) technology has made great progress in science and technology. The project's goal is to develop a facial recognition attendance system for schools in order to improve and enhance the current attendance system. The current legacy system is experiencing considerable confusion, leading to inaccurate onboarding and poor performance. Facial recognition is a process that uses biometric facial recognition based on information technology, such as high-speed video surveillance, to perform facial recognition on students while they are participating. In our project, the computer may be capable of detecting and recognizing faces in images or films captured by community cameras or video display systems. Here, a facial recognition algorithm will be used to identify the face. The finished image is then compared to existing data, and the accession is marked as in the data. The human face is the most unique feature used to identify a person. Therefore, it is used to keep track of characters as there is less chance of different faces or repeats.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Emotion Detection in Voice Data Using Convolutional-LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Stress detection is a critical component of mental-health monitoring and support systems. In this study, we present a novel approach for automated stress detection utilizing deep learning techniques, specifically Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) networks. Our model is designed to process voice data, making it suitable for applications in which stress manifests over a sequence of observations. We constructed a neural network architecture that combines convolutional layers to capture temporal patterns with LSTM layers for sequential analysis. The model was trained on a labeled dataset, enabling it to classify stress levels accurately. We employed the categorical cross-entropy loss function and Adam optimizer to optimize the model parameters. Our experimental results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed approach for stress detection. We achieved a high accuracy and robustness, making it a valuable tool for real-time stress monitoring and intervention systems. We believe that the combination of ConvLSTM networks and adaptive learning rate techniques can pave the way for more accurate and reliable stress detection systems in various domains, including healthcare and mental health.

articleTitle: Medicinal Plant Leaves Classification By SVM-Ensemble PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The recognition and categorization of medicinal plants are essential for their proper utilization and conservation. Recent research has employed computational tools to identify and classify therapeutic plants. PSO is a fact-finding optimization algorithm that draws inspiration from fish and avian social behavior. The data is then processed using SVM ensemble PSO to classify the plants based on their features, leading to better plant management and conservation. An accuracy of 79.31% was achieved in classifying the leaves with 7 plant leaves as least predicted and 12 plant leaves as most predicted from the 30 distinct medicinal plant leaves.

articleTitle: A Survey on Automatic Modulation Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Automatic Modulation Classification (AMC) plays a crucial role in intelligent wireless communications receivers, positioned between signal detection and demodulation. It is a significant component in various applications and faces particular challenges when dealing with blind modulation classification. In this context, AMC operates without access to essential information about the transmitted signal and receiver parameters, such as carrier frequency, signal power, timing data, and segment offsets. It also has to contend with the complexities of frequency-selective, multipath fading, and time-varying channels in real-world scenarios. This survey paper provides a detailed analysis of AMC techniques, categorizing them into two classes: traditional and advanced methods. Traditional approaches include Likelihood-Based (LB) and Feature-Based (FB) methods, which have been the foundation of AMC for many years. In recent times, advanced techniques, particularly Deep Learning (DL), have emerged as a transformative force, pushing the boundaries of AMC capabilities. With a strong focus on the core subject, this paper explores the intricacies of AMC strategies employed to classify various modulation schemes, such as Amplitude Shift Keying (ASK), Phase Shift Keying (PSK), Frequency Shift Keying (FSK), Pulse Amplitude Modulation (PAM), and Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM), each with different orders and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) levels. As the paper concludes, it shifts attention to the future challenges that practitioners and researchers are currently grappling with in the ever-evolving landscape of AMC. We hope that this comprehensive survey is a valuable resource for those involved in the fascinating and essential field of Automatic Modulation Classification.

articleTitle: ETL Pipeline Using Lambda Services
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This survey paper extensively examines the utilization of serverless Lambda functions, with AWS Lambda as a primary exemplar, within Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines. It underscores the compelling advantages of serverless computing, including remarkable scalability, cost-effectiveness, and real-time data processing capabilities, rendering it an appealing choice for ETL tasks. The paper thoroughly dissects the intricacies of architecting ETL workflows using Lambda functions, emphasizing critical factors like scalability, monitoring, data integrity, security, cost optimization, complex workflow management, and resource limitations. Through a comparative analysis, it elucidates the superior merits of Lambda-based ETL over traditional methods, shedding light on reduced operational overhead, automatic scaling, and seamless cloud service integration. This paper serves as an indispensable resource for ETL practitioners, providing a robust framework for leveraging serverless computing’s potential in data processing and analytics, ultimately empowering efficient and cost-effective handling of diverse data sources and facilitating data-driven decision-making. It positions serverless Lambda functions at the forefront of modern ETL pipeline design and implementation, propelling data engineering practices into the future.

articleTitle: “CrimeLock” A Mobile Application for Analysing and Forecasting Crime using Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Crime is one of our society's most intimidating and threatening challenges. With the majority of the population residing in cities, many experts and data provided by local authorities suggest a rapid increase in the number of crimes committed in these cities in recent years. There has been an increasing graph in the crime rates. People living in Sri Lanka has the right to know the exact crime rates and the crime rates in the future of the place they are living in. Due to the current economic crisis the crime rates have spiked. There have been so many thefts and murders recorded within last 6-10 months. There is no solid way of finding out the safety of a place in Sri Lanka. Due to all these reasons, there is a need for the public to feel safe when they are introduced to new places.
