abstract: Rumor detection in the era of online information dissemination is a critical challenge for ensuring the reliability of digital communication. This study explores the potential of hybrid models that incorporate Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) Representation Model, Self-Attention (SA) Model and Bidirectional Encoder Representation for Transformers (BERT) Sentiment Model in combination with diverse Natural Language Processing techniques, to enhance the accuracy of rumor detection. Eight distinct models, Greater Recurrent Unit Representation Model, Self-Attention Model, Bidirectional Encoder Representation for Transformers Sentiment Model, then hybrid models which are combination of two models and three models are considered with well defines voting mechanism to classify the rumors, the models GRU+SA, SA+BERT, BERT+GRU, and GRU+SA+BERT, were rigorously evaluated and compared the performance over various performance metrics Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1 Score. Key discoveries from this study highlight the critical role of hybrid model strengths, particularly with a predefined voting mechanism in rumor detection is significantly bolstering model performance. The hybrid models unveiled an extraordinary potential, with the SA+GRU+BERT model emerging as a standout performer. It achieved an impressive accuracy of 89.7%, a precision rate of 87%, a perfect recall of 97%, and an F1 score of 92%. This innovative approach presents a promising solution for tackling rumor detection tasks, providing a robust foundation for future advancements. As the field of rumor detection continues to evolve, this study offers recommendations encompassing the fine-tuning of hybrid models, ethical considerations, and the importance of real-time monitoring. It underscores the potential of cutting-edge AI solutions in fortifying information accuracy within the online realm, ultimately charting a course for the future of rumor detection.

articleTitle: A Review on Deep Learning Powered Online Product Recommender System in the Digital Market Place
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The rapid growth of digital marketplaces has transformed the way consumers discover and purchase products, necessitating advanced recommender systems to enhance the user experience and drive business success. This paper presents a comprehensive review of personalized online product recommender systems leveraging deep learning techniques in the dynamic landscape of digital marketplaces. One promising use of deep learning is the development of intelligent and tailored recommendation systems, thanks to its capacity to automatically learn complex patterns and representations from large datasets. The review begins by elucidating the fundamental concepts of recommender systems and the evolution of recommendation algorithms over time. Subsequently, it delves into the role of deep learning in revolutionizing personalized recommendations, emphasizing its capability to capture latent user preferences, item features, and intricate user-item interactions. Different deep learning models used in personalized recommender systems are talked about in detail, along with their pros and cons. These models include neural collaborative filtering, recurrent neural networks, and deep autoencoders. This paper critically evaluates methodologies in product recommender systems using deep learning, starting with an exploration of fundamental concepts and the evolution of recommendation algorithms. It examines the benefits and drawbacks of various strategies, addressing potential challenges faced in real-world digital marketplaces, including data sparsity, scalability, and interpretability. Strategies to enhance the robustness of personalized recommendations are discussed, with a spotlight on hybrid models combining deep learning and traditional methods. The last part of the paper gives a thoughtful analysis and outlook on the future of deep learning-based product recommender systems. It stresses the ongoing need for research and new ideas to solve problems and make recommendations more accurate in digital marketplaces that are always changing.

articleTitle: Language Translation Using Transformer and Encoder-Decoder
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Smooth language translation is becoming more and more important in today's globalized society as it promotes efficient communication, knowledge sharing, and intercultural understanding. The study explores the domain of text translation, focusing on English to Russian and Hindi, as well as reverse translation. The primary objective is to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of machine translation systems for these language pairs. Recent advances in language translation are due to neural network-based models. We examine contemporary NMT systems' pre-processing techniques, attention mechanisms, and post-processing strategies, to understand their complicated relationship in producing high-quality translations. Furthermore, the paper explores the concept of transfer learning and multilingual models to improve translation quality across a wide range of language pairs. In conclusion, this paper provides a comprehensive overview of the current landscape of neural machine translation, highlighting the achievements, challenges, and future directions in the field of Machine Translation.

articleTitle: A Survey of Development Approaches for StackOverflow-Style Platform using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Software engineers frequently turn to Stack Overflow to post questions and receive responses. However, since January 2022, traffic to Stack Overflow (stackoverflow.com) has decreased by an average of 6% each month, and in March following Chatgpt, it decreased by 13.9%. So what does experience actually mean? The responses provided by ChatGPT are based on patterns and knowledge acquired during training, therefore they might not always be precise or factually accurate. Beyond its training data, it also has no access to current knowledge or information. Most businesses forbid their staff from visiting StackOverflow.com. The most demanding technology, cloud computing, is integrated with company-specific Stack Overflow development methodologies in this survey study.

articleTitle: Automated News Summarization using Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: News summarization condenses newspaper articles for faster and easier consumption. Nowadays accessing news has become simple and easy. In this day and age, due to the rapid flow of information, numerous articles are as far as a touch of screen, but have limited time to consume the information, so it is required to create a news summarization system to access the summary of news and this task is done by using a simple T5 model, an abstractive transformer-based model, developed by Google AI. Pre-trained on the C4 dataset, the T5 model can be fine-tuned for the summarization process. The aim is to improve comprehension and efficiency when reading news articles. T5's abstractive approach enables it to generate summaries by understanding the context and meaning of the text. This allows the system to handle large news articles and extract the most important information. This system works on the transformer model called T5 Model, which allows the summarizing of the news articles by the process of configuration, tokenization, fine-tuning, encoding-decoding and evaluation. The system has conducted trials against some news articles and it has managed to summarize and through comparing the results with the human-generated summaries, a success rate of 55% was obtained.

articleTitle: A Review of Deep Learning Methods for Early Prediction of Pancreatic Cancer in High-Risk Populations
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: As the world's second-most frequent cancer, pancreatic adenocarcinoma maintains its status as one of the deadliest malignancies globally. Pancreatic cancer poses a dire prediction, with a mere five-year persistence rate despite extensive research efforts. This challenging malignancy, originating from the pancreas, is elusive in its early phases, often manifesting through jaundice and sudden weight loss. Early detection and improved survival hinge on the potential benefits of treatment for a larger population. Machine and deep learning algorithms, proven effective in general healthcare, emerge as viable tools for classifying or detecting the risk of pancreatic cancer. Focusing on the use of deep learning techniques in the ever-changing domain of digital pathology, this study offers a thorough overview of deep learning methods for early pancreatic cancer prediction. The review starts by explaining the basics of pancreatic cancer and how deep learning models have changed over time. Then it moves on to examine several models that are used for early pancreatic cancer prediction. Detailed discussions on the pros and cons of these models are provided. The paper critically evaluates methodologies for early prediction of pancreatic cancer using deep learning, addressing challenges such as data sparsity, scalability, and interpretability in real-world environments. Additionally, the benefits and drawbacks of various strategies are examined, with a particular emphasis on hybrid models that combine deep learning and traditional methods to enhance robustness. The review contributes to a comprehensive understanding of the evolving landscape of deep learning in the forecast of pancreatic cancer, offering insights into its effectiveness in identifying high-risk individuals and facilitating early intervention strategies within high-risk populations.

articleTitle: Analyzing Sports Videos Using Computer Vision Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Recent developments in video analysis of sports and computer vision techniques have enabled significant improvements in a variety of critical operations. In this survey paper, we analyze the use of computer vision methods for analyzing sports videos. We review the state-of-the-art studies that have employed computer vision techniques for different tasks, including ball tracking, content analysis, and complex analysis in sports such as soccer, basketball, cricket, and badminton. We inspect the key points and weaknesses of these methodologies and investigate whether they can be utilized in real-time sports video analysis systems. Our survey mainly focuses on providing a comprehensive review of research carried out in computer vision-based sports video analysis for analyzing sports videos. The survey aims to identify open issues, future trends, and research directions in this field.

articleTitle: An Optimized Edge Detection Algorithm for Computer Vision and Robot Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Many computer vision applications rely on edge detection, such as medical picture classification, form matching, and article recognition. Consequently, In the past, edge detectors such as LOG, Prewitt, Canny, and others were developed to increase the accuracy of edge pixel grouping. Images with significant intensity variance produce uneven results when using these methods, notwithstanding their effectiveness for photos with low-intensity change. Therefore, "Binary Particle Swarm Optimization (BPSO)" is a new edge detection mechanism introduced in this paper to minimize a fitness function that considers multiple objectives. For each of the four edge validation methods, we assign a weight to one of the five cost components; from this, we get the multi-objective fitness function. The proposed methodology is tested. Next, we use the F score performance metric to compare the acquired results with traditional edge detection algorithms (Canny, Prewitt) and methods for computational intelligence (ACO, SA).

articleTitle: Marketing In Quantum Age: The Role of Predictive Analytics and Quantum Machine Learning For Customized Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: In the context of swift technological progress, the notion of “Marketing in the Quantum Age” arises as a new field that combines marketing techniques with principles from quantum computing to transform how consumers and brands interact. The present work explores the potential for transformation offered by quantum learning machines. The aim is to change traditional marketing practices by enhancing customization and equipping computers with unparalleled analytical skills. This study examines the usage of quantum computation in the marketing domain, specifically emphasizing creating customer-specific marketing strategies through the development and deployment of quantum learning technologies. Quantum learning machines can do intricate computations at unparalleled speeds, owing to the distinctive attributes of quantum bits (qubits), in contrast to traditional computers. The study methodology integrates quantum computer principles with machine learning techniques, focusing on using quantum learning machines. By using the principles of parallelism and superposition inherent in quantum bits (qubits), quantum learning machines can execute intricate computations faster than traditional machines. This Research aims to explore the potential of quantum algorithms in generating new perspectives on customer behavior, hence facilitating marketers in creating customized and focused advertising campaigns.Moreover, this study makes a valuable contribution to the growing field of quantum-enhanced marketing by showcasing the tangible implementation of quantum learning techniques. Organizations desiring to adapt their marketing strategies using quantum technology must consider the implications carefully. These findings demonstrate the possible evolution of safe and personalized customer interactions in the Quantum Age.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based approach for Myocardial Infarction Prediction using real time ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This project focuses on utilizing machine learning techniques to identify and detect abnormal cardiac conditions through the analysis of Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. With cardiovascular diseases being a significant global health concern, the need for precise diagnostic tools is paramount. The primary objectives of this study involve identifying specific cardiac conditions, including Myocardial Infarction, Arrhythmias and discerning normal cardiac conditions. Real time ECG signals were taken from Symbiosis hospital and research center pvt. Limited hospital in Satara. The methodology encompasses the acquisition of diverse ECG datasets, preprocessing to enhance signal quality, and feature extraction to characterize different cardiac conditions effectively. Support vector machines (SVMs), logistic regression, kNNs, and XGBoost these machine learning techniques are employed to develop robust classification models. The anticipated outcomes of this research aim to provide accurate models capable of early detection, enabling prompt interventions and, ultimately, enhancing patient outcomes within the domain of cardiovascular health.

articleTitle: An Algorithmic Approaches for Maximizing Return on Investment (ROI) Using Simple Moving Average (SMAC)
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: This paper investigates the LEGO toy sets as a good investment and proposes a Simple Moving Average Crossover (SMAC) for maximum return on investment (ROI). Recently, LEGO has provided better-quality toy sets, enabling everyone to experience better gaming and collection value. This increased the value of LEGO toys and made the investors rethink their investments, allowing them to gain colossal profits. This research focuses on the actual and trading prices of the various LEGO sets in the market. Furthermore, this research aims to design a return on investment algorithm and propose a maximum return for LEGO collectibles items. However, in this research, we also develop a working prototype for evaluation and data visualization for the proposed trading algorithm. This algorithm is used to calculate ROI for LEGO collectible items and its effective chosen strategy for maximizing ROI for LEGO collectible items. Based on the findings of the study, investing in LEGO sets is a low-risk option that does not require extensive financial knowledge. This makes an attractive investment opportunity, simplifying the investment process and making it possible to earn high returns for LEGO enthusiasts and investors. The future scope of this research may incorporate machine learning or deep learning techniques, such as linear regression or random forest, for highly accurate predictions.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review of Diagnosis and Prognostication Techniques for Brain Ventriculomegaly Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: A disorder known as ventriculomegaly causes the cerebral ventricles in the developing fetal brain to expand. For proper therapy and prognostication of afflicted fetuses, prompt diagnosis and precise ventriculomegaly classification are essential. Recent developments in algorithms that employ deep learning have proven assure in a variety of medical imaging applications, such as the analysis of embryonic brain abnormalities. The research question driving this review is: "How effectively have deep learning methods been utilized for the diagnosis and prediction of brain ventriculomegaly, and what are the key findings, limitations, and trends in this area?"A thorough search strategy was used to find pertinent articles for this systematic review that were published in peer-reviewed journals, conference proceedings, and other pertinent sources. Deep learning, brain ventriculomegaly, diagnosis, and prognostication-related keywords were utilized to find papers. Select research that concentrated on using deep learning methods to diagnose brain ventriculomegaly and forecast its prognosis were subjected to inclusion and exclusion criteria.22 studies in total that satisfied the inclusion criteria were found during the review. Collectively, this research showed that there is considerable interest in using deep learning techniques to the diagnosis and prognosis of brain ventriculomegaly. The chosen research used a variety of deep learning architectures, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), and attention mechanisms. These research' findings revealed promising diagnostic precision and prognostic skills. Deep learning models demonstrated the capacity to precisely identify brain ventriculomegaly from MRI and CT scan data. Some studies also emphasized the potential of deep learning methods for forecasting the development of ventriculomegaly and related outcomes.Collectively, the research under evaluation indicate that deep learning algorithms are capable of efficiently analyzing complicated medical imaging data and supporting the early and precise diagnosis of ventriculomegaly. Additionally, the possibility for ventriculomegaly progression and prognosis prediction utilizing these approaches provides useful information for individualized patient care and treatment planning. However, it's critical to recognize the restrictions found in all of the research under consideration, including difficulties with data accessibility, model interpretability, and generalizability. To fully achieve the clinical potential of deep learning in the context of brain ventriculomegaly diagnosis and prognostication, overcoming these constraints and doing additional research will be essential as the area of deep learning continues to develop.

articleTitle: Home Automation without Internet to Run Electrical Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: Everyone is familiar with the usage of internet these days. It may raise the standard of living and make life more comfortable. Controlling every electrical appliance in our house with a single touch over the internet has become necessary. The internet not only grants us independence but also total relaxation with the ability to operate our household appliances from any location at any time. The internet might produce issues from time to time. A bad internet connection will cause the command time to be delayed and may even result in dangerous situations. Cyber-attacks may impact your internet-connected smart home, exposing all the safeguarded data and your private information. These are relay modules with a NodeMCU (ESP8266). NodeMCU is mostly used as a low-cost open source, which contains firmware to run on the Wi-Fi-based mode that is interfaced with JavaScript software that uses the HTTP request mechanism to operate the microcontroller. The major objective of employing relays is to operate the electrical switches remotely from the server, which would be interconnected with electrical devices to work in a simple manner. In this project, Zigbee or Z-wave protocols are used to operate all home gadgets without the need for constant internet access.

articleTitle: Exploring LLMs as a means for conducting Bias-free technical Interviews
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: We present a novel approach to conducting technical interviews using a conversational AI agent. Traditional technical interviews have constraints like interviewer biases, human errors, and subjective evaluations. To address these issues, we propose a conversational AI agent that conducts and assesses technical interviews in a fair and objective manner. The conversational AI agent uses natural language processing (NLP) techniques and machine learning algorithms to simulate a real-time conversation between the interviewer and the interviewee. The agent is designed to ask relevant technical questions and evaluate the candidate's responses based on predefined criteria. We conducted experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of the conversational AI agent in conducting technical interviews. The results showed that the agent was able to conduct interviews efficiently, provide objective evaluations, and eliminate biases. Moreover, the agent was discovered to be reliable and consistent in its assessments, turning it into a useful resource for recruiting managers and recruiters.

articleTitle: A Survey on the State-Of-the-art Quantum Communication Systems with Photonics in a 6G Network: Techniques, Open Problems and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: With a rising percentage of enterprise 5G installations, studies on 6G as well have begun seriously. While it is far too premature to predict when or how 6G networks will appear, it can be predicted that 6G platforms are going to allow applications enabled by technological innovations and network designs. Simultaneous with the expansion of cell phone networks from 5G to 6G, quantum communication networks have developed quickly in the last decade. In 6G, quantum communication technologies might offer an unparalleled degree of safety, keeping private information safe from prospective listeners. Furthermore, the utilization of photonics provides rapid communication with minimal latency, thereby increasing the system's overall effectiveness. Photonics is critical in quantum systems for communication. Quantum data is encoded and transmitted using photons. Yet, various security vulnerabilities affecting both encryption and authentication mechanisms are being investigated. As a result, procedures based on quantum communication equipment are being investigated in order to enhance safety. As a result, this summary gives a comprehensive overview of the characterization of quantum communication systems using photonics in a 6G system. In this survey, we discuss the machine learning, deep learning, and cryptography-based strategies for building safe and reliable quantum communication networks are separated and stated, and trends in every direction for quantum communication network trust management are comprehensively investigated. Following that, the sources of data along with simulation tools, such as QKDNetSim, OMNeT++, and QX Simulator, are to be investigated and classified. In conclusion, quantum communication technologies in a 6G system have enormous promise for redefining safe communication, creating a fascinating topic for academics and researchers worldwide to examine.

articleTitle: AI ML Based Smart Healthcare Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Intelligent Systems and Machine Learning Conference (ISML)
abstract: The Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies is causing a revolution in the healthcare sector. This article presents a comprehensive design for an advanced healthcare system driven by AI and machine learning. This system aims to streamline operational processes, improve patient results, and facilitate the efficient allocation of resources. The suggested solution makes use of AI-ML models to make it easier to analyze complex medical data, giving healthcare professionals immediate insights that help them to make wise decisions. Proactive interventions and preventive actions are made possible by the use of predictive analytics to forecast prospective health hazards. This survey research investigates the role of technology in assisting with physician referrals when problems are suspected and in predicting diseases based on basic symptoms. It addresses wearable technology, telemedicine platforms, wearable data collecting, and AI approaches. The study provides insights for stakeholders in healthcare by emphasizing ethical considerations and practical applications. Improved patient outcomes and early disease diagnosis are potential benefits of smart healthcare systems.The main aim of the application is to provide all the medical facilities easily and remotely so that all the patient can be diagnosed smoothly with the top doctors of the country. The AI ML technique in this system will help the patient to know from which diseases they are suffering from.
